title: Beyond Third-Person Audits: Situated Interaction Auditing for User-Centered LLM Bias Research
abstract: arXiv:2606.12247v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Research on bias in large language models (LLMs) has predominantly focused on third-person audits, which study how models represent or evaluate demographic groups as external subjects. However, this paradigm overlooks a structural blind spot because the user is absent from the audit. In practice, LLMs are used in open-ended, personal interactions, during which the model implicitly represents the user and adjusts its responses accordingly. When identical requests yield different responses depending on who is asking, bias manifests not in how the model describes others but in how it treats its interlocutor. Empirical first-person bias studies are multiplying, but they use different cues, outcomes, and validation choices, which makes their results hard to compare. translated_title: 超越第三人称审计：面向以用户为中心的大语言模型偏见研究的情境化交互审计
translated_abstract: 关于大语言模型（LLM）偏见的研究主要集中于第三人称审计，即研究模型如何将人口群体作为外部对象进行表征或评价。然而，这一范式忽视了一个结构性盲点——用户在审计中是缺席的。在实践中，LLM被用于开放式的、个人化的交互之中，在此过程中模型会隐性地表征用户并据此调整其回答。当相同的请求因提问者不同而产生不同的回答时，偏见并非体现在模型如何描述他人，而是体现在它如何对待自己的对话者。实证性的第一人称偏见研究正在迅速增多，但它们使用了不同的线索、结果指标和验证方式，导致研究结果之间难以比较。我们提出了情境化交互审计（SIA），作为针对这一研究领域的共享诊断框架。该框架引入了用户画像信号的类型学——姓名和表面标记等……
tldr: 该论文提出了情境化交互审计（SIA）这一共享诊断框架，将大语言模型偏见研究从第三人称审计扩展到以用户为中心的第一人称交互审计，填补了用户在偏见审计中缺席的结构性盲点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Situated Interaction Auditing (SIA), a shared diagnostic framework that extends LLM bias research beyond third-person audits to user-centered, first-person interaction auditing, addressing the structural blind spot caused by the user's absence from bias audits.
